nom: Rael Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm

segments.oily: One reviewer with extremely oily, textured skin found this an effective oil cleanser that didn't sting, though she still needed a second cleanse to remove all makeup traces.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including some with eczema, consistently report the balm removes makeup without stripping their skin, leaving it moisturized rather than tight or flaky.
segments.combination: A reviewer with breakout-prone combination skin says it didn't trigger any new flare-ups.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers overwhelmingly report no redness, irritation or barrier issues, though one reviewer had a reaction the first time she used it (though not on a second try) and flags it as something ultra-sensitive skin should keep in mind.
segments.normal: A couple of reviewers describe their skin as normal-to-dry or 'regular' skin that gets dry with active ingredients, and say the balm didn't dry them out further.
segments.mature: A reviewer with mature, dry skin says the balm is gentle and hydrating, leaving her face smooth rather than tight or greasy.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across dry, sensitive and mature skin, report the balm cleanses without stripping moisture, leaving skin soft and hydrated rather than tight; one reviewer, however, found it left her skin slightly dry.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers, including one with extremely sensitive skin and one focused on repairing a damaged barrier, report the balm is the rare cleanser that doesn't compromise or 'break' their barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers, including one with breakout-prone combination skin, report no new flare-ups and some say it helped unclog pores.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no redness or irritation after use, including one who has dealt with redness for most of her life and credits the heartleaf extract with soothing it.

extraits.texte: Great concept, nice packaging, but it can't remove even light makeup even after several attempts It ran out soo fast, I was dissappointed

extraits.titre: Effective at getting the job done.
extraits.texte: I've been using the new Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm by Rael Beauty for a few weeks now, and so far, I've really been enjoying it. I love the twisted feature of this balm; it makes it super easy to get just the right amount without having to touch the entire product or risk spreading germs. It applies smoothly and evenly on the skin, and a little goes a long way. That being said, although I like the twist-up feature, the packaging is a little bulky for traveling with. It does a great job breaking down dirt, grime, and makeup off; and worked even water-proof makeup; leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean. I did notice a bit of a reaction the very first time I used it, even though it's designed for sensitive skin. I'm not sure if that was just a one-time thing, because when I tried it again later, I didn't have any issues. Still, if you have ultra-sensitive skin, it's something to keep in mind. Overall, I've been really happy with this cleanser. It's been an effective, new addition to my daily skincare routine. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

extraits.titre: 4.5 Stars — Great Option for Oily-Sensitive Skin!
extraits.texte: I bought this on a whim because I'd heard good things about Rael and I was on a hunt for an effective oil cleanser. I've got extremely oily and textured skin, so I absolutely need a solid oil cleanser. This one was almost a five star. The packaging is clever and felt more hygienic. It melts easily into a lightweight oil that doesn't sting or burn in any way (for sensitive skin folks like me). I felt it didnt remove ALL traces of makeup, so it's necessary to double cleanse. In total, it lasted me about 3 months of use for daily washing.

As someone with EXTREMELY dry skin I LOVE balm cleansers. This one is incredibly moisturizing and does a fantastic job at removing FACE makeup. However it's not too great at removing mascara. But as a girly with eczema flare ups on her face, this did a GREAT job at not only not stripping my skin and making it feel dry, but leaving my face feeling extremely moisturized!

I received the Rael Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm as part of an educational promotion, and I've been using it for about two weeks now. Honestly, I wasn't expecting much, I've tried a lot of cleansing balms that either leave a weird residue or break me out. But this one surprised me in a good way. First off, the twist-up packaging is genius. It keeps things clean and mess-free, which I really appreciate. Most cleansing balms come in jars, and I don't love dipping my fingers in every time. This feels more hygienic and travel friendly. As for the product itself, it goes on super smoothly and melts into an oil quickly, which makes removing makeup, even stubborn waterproof mascara really easy. It doesn't tug or pull at the skin, and I haven't noticed any irritation. I have combination skin that's breakout prone, and this balm didn't cause any new flare ups. The scent is very mild, not too perfumey or overwhelming which is a big plus for me. After rinsing, my skin feels clean but not stripped, and it leaves a soft, almost moisturized finish. I still follow up with a gentle foaming cleanser to double cleanse, but I probably wouldn't have to.

I have struggled with acne and redness for most of my life, so having a good cleaning routine is essential. This was my first time trying a cleansing balm as I was raised to keep my skin dry and not moisturized, so it would not break out. I have been focusing on, repairing my skin barrier, and finding good hydration that does not clog my pores. Rael Beauty purifying twist up cleansing balm Feels more like a spa treatment, then washing my face at night. The balm is delivered in small shavings. They're easy to scoop without the mess of digging into a jar. The product is extremely hydrating on my skin and easily dissolves my makeup, and any products throughout the day while still leaving my skin, feeling clean, and even nourished. The heart leaf extract is my favorite ingredient, since I am always dealing with redness, and finding a product that helps soothe the irritation is really important for me. I received this as part of an educational promotion.
I have extremely sensitive skin.. ive tried so many cleansing balms & this is the only one that doesnt break my barrier! My skin felt incredibly soft & hydrated afterwards.
